prompt:
Clean HD painterly 2D game VFX sprite sheet, NOT pixel art, warm painted anime style matching the attached reference (the fox-fire effects of Mika, nine-tailed fox girl with a crescent moon glaive): the same fire colours and painting, white-gold bright core, golden-orange fox-fire, crimson flame tongues, a few cream-tipped fox-tail-shaped wisps.

Opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, no soft haze, no glow halo spreading into the background, no smoke. Keep a magenta margin inside every cell edge; nothing crosses into a neighbouring cell. No glaive, no character, no enemy.
Uniform pure flat #FF00FF magenta background, no gradients, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no floor, no shadows.
